name: Hong Leong Bank Berhad
overview: 2026年，Hong Leong Bank Berhad 的公告主要涉及公司治理、股息派发和股东大会等事项，未披露各业务板块的扩张、新增、缩减或合约签订等具体动态。最新季度营收同比增长7.9%，净利润同比增长14.2%。
overview_en: In 2026, Hong Leong Bank Berhad's announcements mainly covered corporate governance, dividend payments, and general meetings, with no specific developments disclosed regarding expansion, new business, reduction, or contracts for its business segments. Latest quarterly revenue grew 7.9% year-on-year and net profit grew 14.2% year-on-year.
